messages:
Alex (AE): Quick sync — ACME is ready to move to PO/MSA but legal pushed DPA + HSM requests. Need signature routing + billing path. Who can confirm?
Priya (Legal): I looked at their redlines. They want EU data residency, HSM attestation, and a shortened SLA cure period. We can accept most DPA edits but need to tighten the indemnity language in §7.2.
Marco (Finance): Net45 is ok. We need PO number, remit-to address, and the exact orderform fields so their AP can ingest. Also confirm invoice email.
Sam (SE): For HSM: we support BYOK via customer KMS for Dedicated and Private. For Hosted, we can provide a documented attestation of our HSM provider; full attestation takes ~5 business days. Suggest we add a fallback (software-encrypted keys) in the orderform.
ACME Procurement: We need the orderform in structured JSON so our system can auto-populate. Also confirm monthly commitment, region (eu-west-1), and SLA 99.9.
Alex (AE): Draft orderform snippet below — feel free to copy into their AP import: 
```json
{"customer":"ACME Corp","order_id":"TBD","product":"Redwood Dedicated","region":"eu-west-1","commitment_months":12,"units":4,"monthly_amount":"120000","billing_contact":"payables@acmecorp.com","escalation_contact":"eng-lead@acmecorp.com","support_sla":"99.9%"}
```
Priya (Legal): I'll push an MSA patch that accepts data residency clause but proposes alternate indemnity text. Also attaching the subprocessor list. contracts-bot: new draft uploaded to /contracts/ACME/MSA_v3.pdf by @Priya.
contracts-bot: Document: MSA_v3.pdf (uploaded) — version 3, reviewer Priya (Legal).
Nina (Ops): For e-sign: route DocuSign envelope to countersign to legal@redwood.com and finance@redwood.com. If ACME requires physical signature, escalate to @sales-lead for approval for wet-ink.
ACME Procurement: Also need confirmation of KMS/HSM vendor and whether we can get an attestation letter for compliance.
Sam (SE): HSM vendor = Thales (partner). Attestation letter is available; standard lead time 3-5 business days. If they need SOC2 + HSM attestation combined, that will be the 5 business-day path.
Marco (Finance): Once we receive PO and validated orderform JSON, route to invoices@redwood.com and CC me (marco@redwood.com). I'll set net45 on the billing record.
Alex (AE): I'll prepare the DocuSign request after Priya confirms the MSA patch. @Priya @Marco please react when you approve for send. :thumbsup:
Priya (Legal): Reviewing now, will post updated DPA + subproc list in this thread by EOD.
Marco (Finance): Ack. Waiting on PO.
Alex (AE): Thanks team — plan: 1) Priya posts final MSA/DPA; 2) I attach structured orderform and send DocuSign; 3) Marco finalizes billing record after PO. I'll update here when envelope sent. :rocket:
